stem.text: X is an organic compound containing the elements carbon, hydrogen and oxygen only.
The table shows the observations made from three chemical tests carried out on X.
What is a possible structure of X?

A.alt: Skeletal formula: HO on a carbon with a vertical methyl bond above, a zigzag chain to the right, and a COOH group at the right end (OH above, C=O below).

B.alt: Skeletal formula: C=O at the upper left of a zigzag chain, an OH group hanging from a carbon at the bottom, and a terminal CH3 at the right.

C.alt: Skeletal formula: O=CH attached to a quaternary carbon that carries an OH group below it and two methyl branches (one vertical, one to the right).

D.alt: Skeletal formula: a COOH group (C=O and OH) on the left, bonded to a quaternary carbon that carries an OH group below it and two methyl branches (one vertical, one to the right).
